$comment: Canonical project list. Rendered by components/Projects and indexed for the chatbot. 'tech' holds plain names - the component maps them to icons via components/Projects/icons.ts. Run 'yarn rag:build' after editing.

projects.name: Gamatron — AI App Builder
projects.desc: Build apps without code using AI. A no-code platform powered by LLMs that lets you create full applications through natural language prompts.
highlights: Natural-language prompt to full application generation
LLM-powered no-code builder shipped as a live web app

projects.name: Gama AI — RAG Chatbot
projects.desc: Agentic RAG chatbot built with LangChain, FAISS vector store, and streaming responses. Uses retrieval-augmented generation to answer questions about my portfolio.
highlights: Retrieval-augmented generation over a FAISS vector store
Token-by-token streaming responses with live status steps
Multi-source indexing: resume PDF, website content and a knowledge folder
Per-answer thumbs up/down feedback and usage analytics

projects.name: Multi-Agent Orchestrator
projects.desc: LangGraph-based multi-agent system with tool-calling, shared memory, and conditional routing across specialized AI agents.

projects.name: MCP Tool Server
projects.desc: Model Context Protocol server exposing custom tools for LLM agents — file search, code analysis, and data retrieval via standardized MCP interface.
highlights: Implements the Model Context Protocol for tool interoperability
Tools for file search, code analysis and data retrieval

projects.name: Tesseract OCR + AI
projects.desc: Multi-language document OCR pipeline enhanced with LLM post-processing for structured data extraction.
highlights: LLM post-processing turns raw OCR text into structured records

projects.name: Teasit PWA
projects.desc: Full-featured social media PWA with real-time messaging and AI-assisted content moderation.
highlights: Realtime messaging plus AI-assisted content moderation

projects.name: Video Editor Service
projects.desc: AI-driven server-side video processing pipeline using FFmpeg with automated scene detection.

projects.name: Xpense Wala
projects.desc: Personal expense tracker with AI-powered spending insights and category-based budgeting.

projects.desc: Real-time chat app with Socket.io, message history, and LLM-powered smart replies.
